title: Flex the Navbar
prompt:
Turn the boilerplate's nav into a flex navbar:

- `.nav` becomes a flex container with `space-between` (brand left, links right) and vertically centered items.
- `.nav ul` also becomes flex, with a `1rem` gap between links and no list bullets.
- Style links without underline on `.nav a` (in a nav, color+weight carry the affordance) — and set `color` explicitly.
boilerplate:
MySite
  • Home
  • About
  • Contact

tests.name: nav is flex with space-between
tests.hint: display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; — the navbar trio.

tests.name: ul is flex with gap and no bullets
tests.hint: Flex containers nest: .nav ul { display: flex; gap: 1rem; list-style: none; }

tests.name: links styled, underline dropped deliberately
tests.hint: .nav a { color: …; text-decoration: none; } — scoped to the nav, not all links.
